summary: Tested the Admin module end to end: RBAC (/me, enforcement of sections, roles PUT), insights (overview/geo/business), profile geo fields, member sharing (backend + UI), the /admin UI with the password (all 8 tabs, KPIs, funnel, periods, geo, business, Roles tab) and the /admin UI as a member (marketing). I found and fixed one CRITICAL frontend bug: AdminDashboard.jsx called setMe but never declared the `me` state, so every admin login (password and member) failed with 'setMe is not defined'. After the one-line fix, all requested flows pass. 41/41 backend pytest pass.

minor.issue: Funnel 'Visiteurs' = max(distinct sessions, cohort). Activité shows 3 visitors but the funnel shows Visiteurs 54 = Inscrits 54 (100 %). So the first conversion rate is always 100 % and does not tell anything. Show the real visitor count, or label the step as an estimate.

Mapped to the 'activite' section, so Marketing/Support can download the CSV/XLSX of ATS analyses. Its 'entreprise' column holds generated report text (company culture, interview questions). This is not a CV, but check it fits the privacy promise.
Open to Marketing/Support. The 'Tester les fournisseurs IA' button triggers real paid LLM calls. Consider limiting it to super_admin.
Role normalisation only changes case: 'Analyste' and 'Analyst' are counted as separate roles. The 'Analysées (total)' detail reuses the 30 j title 'Offres analysées par source (30 j)'.
'London' always maps to Ontario, Canada, even for 'London, UK'. If a member clears Pays/Province/Ville, GET /profile deduces them again, so the member cannot leave them empty.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: `const [me, setMe] = useState(null)` was missing. Admin login (password and member) always showed the error 'setMe is not defined' and the dashboard never loaded.

issues: Field labels are raw keys (headline, goals, certifications, education, languages) instead of French labels.
The dialog looks translucent and low-contrast: page inputs show through behind the text.
During the close animation the dialog flashes '0 ligne(s)' (detail set to null before the dialog finishes closing).
Sections are listed alphabetically by key (Activité · Analyse métier · Connecteurs…), not in tab order.

action_items: Review the setMe fix in AdminDashboard.jsx (line 71) and run lint/ESLint no-undef before handoff.
Make the funnel 'Visiteurs' step meaningful (do not use max with the cohort, or label it).
Decide whether /api/admin/export and /api/admin/llm-health (paid LLM test) should be limited to super_admin.
Use French labels in the SharingPanel shared view and fix the dialog's background contrast in the light theme.
Keep the last detail in DetailDialog while it closes, to avoid the '0 ligne(s)' flash.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx used an undeclared state (me/setMe). This should have been caught by ESLint no-undef or a smoke test.
Roles.jsx toggle uses the `local` state captured at click time. Rapid consecutive toggles on different rows can overwrite each other (use a functional setState).

RBAC middleware: members with a role but an expired access token get 401 (fine). The ContextVar is set before call_next, so it propagates correctly (verified: super_admin-role member can PUT roles and read finance).
Geo merge (<3) is applied correctly for non-super roles. Insights payloads contain no '@' and no cv_text (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the setMe fix (0% before: admin login fully blocked)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test sharing grants were created and revoked (0 active grants remain). Roles restored: membre.test=['marketing'], conseiller.test=['conseiller']. The conseiller.test profile geo was set temporarily and then restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_admin_rbac_insights_sharing.py (pytest.ini adds -n xdist). In the UI, accept privacy-banner (privacy-accept-btn). conseiller.test gets a guided tour dialog on /careeros/memoire: click tour-skip first. Revoking sharing uses window.confirm (accept the dialog).
rca of the issue: Admin login failure: load() calls setMe(m), but the useState declaration for `me` was missing in AdminDashboard. This throws a ReferenceError, which the catch block shows as the login error and then resets authed. Mitigation: added `const [me, setMe] = useState(null);`.
